correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 12v 18e Tietze graph via two isomorphic definitions; exhaustive 1051-face enumeration, 517 matched unit pairs and 3744 directed incidences establish acyclic Morse CW model with 1 critical 0-cell and 16 critical 3-cells. Flag-complex minimum carrier lemma proves sharp bound eight; all 63 octahedra are exhaustively enumerated and their 16-term cycles have exactly zero boundaries. Integral unit-pivot elimination gives homology coordinates and is checked to annihilate every four-boundary; explicit 16x16 determinant is -1 for eight central pairs, proving actual integral regular-C2 basis and eight independent Z/2 quotient directions. Independent flower-graph and signed-Lefschetz verification reproduces ranks and character. No infinite-family statement is made.

value.rationale: The smallest non-Hamiltonian cubic graph, a canonical triangle expansion of the Petersen graph, has natural ordinary matching-complex homology beyond enumeration: exactly 63 geometrically minimal 3-sphere carriers. Eight exchanged octahedral pairs produce an integral basis and expose (Z/2)^8 missed by rational invariant/anti-invariant splitting, a meaningful lattice obstruction with natural graph symmetry. The precise invariant is motivated by minimum geometric support and integral equivariance, not a random parameter slice.
